entities.summary: Masjid Al-Amin or the Al-Amin Mosque is a mosque located at Telok Blangah in the Central Region, Singapore. Built in 1991 under the second phase of the Mosque Building Fund, the building's architecture is inspired by classical Malay and Minangkabau styles. It is also the second mosque recorded in history to have been built in Telok Blangah.
